Build the fintech future together.

At i2c, we don’t just build technology — we build careers that grow with you and your family. Kick your i2c journey into high gear with a company engineered for growth, innovation and meaningful impact.

Fast-Track
your Career Submit your Resume

4 Global office locations.

1,600 Employees worldwide.

70+ Open positions.

One team without borders.

Bring your best. Get the best.

At i2c, we don’t just fill job positions—we fuel careers. We develop leaders who thrive in an environment that values teamwork and personal growth, think creatively and strive for success every day.

Growth isn’t a goal, it is a given. Our team members are rewarded for their work far beyond just a salary. Join i2c and accelerate your journey with long-term career growth and security.

Built to support you, every step of the way.

Your wellbeing goes beyond the workday. At i2c, we back you with benefits that protect your health, support your family, and help you build lasting financial security — so you can focus on what matters, at work and at home.

Save with confidence knowing i2c matches your contributions. We match 4% on the first 5% of eligible employee contributions — so your retirement savings grow faster, right from day one.

Every i2c employee has access to medical, dental, and vision coverage for themselves and their family. That means you can focus on doing your best work, knowing your health is taken care of.

With Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA options, you can set aside pre-tax dollars for medical and dependent care costs. That means more of your paycheck stays in your pocket, working for you instead of the taxman.

Work fuels. Culture rules.

From competitive benefits to meaningful learning opportunities, every i2c team member is equipped to thrive on—and off—the track. Because when our people thrive, the whole team moves faster.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

The Employee Assistance Program provides confidential resources and support for employees and their families, including:

Mental Health Support.

We know mental health is just as important as physical health. Our program connects you with confidential counseling and support resources, whenever you need someone to talk to.

Crisis Intervention.

When the unexpected happens, you shouldn’t have to face it alone. Our crisis support gives you immediate access to help, so you can get through difficult moments with confidence.

Educational Resources.

Growth doesn’t stop at work. We provide access to resources and tools that support your learning and development, wherever your curiosity takes you.

Legal & Financial Consultation.

Big decisions deserve expert guidance. Our program connects you with legal and financial consultation, so you can navigate important matters with clarity and peace of mind.

Relationship & Family Support.

Life’s relationships aren’t always easy to navigate. We offer guidance and support to help you strengthen the connections that matter most, at home and beyond.

Dependent Care & Caregiving Assistance.

Caring for others shouldn’t come at the cost of your own wellbeing. We help you find the right support and resources for dependent care and caregiving responsibilities.

Lifestyle Support.

A fulfilling life goes beyond the workplace. Our lifestyle support resources help you manage everyday challenges, so you can stay balanced and focused on what matters.

Work-Life Management.

Balance looks different for everyone. We offer tools and support to help you manage the demands of work and life, so you can thrive in both.
